title: Sweden-based Trustly, which lets merchants accept payments via bank transfers, raised $60M from Nordic Capital and others, taking its total funding to $450M+ (John Reynolds/Tech.eu)
summary: John Reynolds / Tech.eu: Sweden-based Trustly, which lets merchants accept payments via bank transfers, raised $60M from Nordic Capital and others, taking its total funding to $450M+ — Trustly has raised the funds from existing investors. — Swedish fintech Trustly today confirmed it had completed a $60m funding round …
contentText:
John Reynolds / Tech.eu :

Sweden-based Trustly, which lets merchants accept payments via bank transfers, raised $60M from Nordic Capital and others, taking its total funding to $450M+   —  Trustly has raised the funds from existing investors.  —  Swedish fintech Trustly today confirmed it had completed a $60m funding round …
